description: This file is a PHP class that defines an OpenCart admin controller for managing length classes in the localisation module. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting length class entries, and handles the associated views and data processing.

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: Controller class in the Opencart admin module responsible for managing length classes used in localisation settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the length class list view, set page title, breadcrumbs, and include common header, footer, and column components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Alias to refresh the list view, outputs the list of length classes.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of length classes, handles pagination, and returns the rendered list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a length class, populating data if editing an existing entry.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission for creating or updating a length class, including validation and saving data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected length classes after permission and product association checks.
